title: Madhya-khanda, part 15 (portion 38)
html:
The section "Vishnupriya's Lament": Vishnupriya learns of the coming sannyasa and begs the Lord not to leave; the Lord consoles her, instructs her and shows her His four-armed form; Srivasa asks to be taken along; in Murari's house the Lord tells him to worship Advaita. The section "The Consolation of the Devotees" (only in the 1983 edition): the last days at home and the last night with Vishnupriya

Vishnupriya's Lament

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. [When mother Shachi could not tell] her of this, Vishnupriya-devi, beside herself with grief, wept unceasingly, and [the Lord] asked her the reason for her tears. Vishnupriya-devi laid her grief at the Lord's feet; [He], [learning] the cause of her grief, consoled her with many sweet words and at last, giving her full instruction in the truth — [that it is vain] to see one's husband in a body of blood and flesh [and that the true Lord of the soul's life is Sri Hari], — showed Vishnupriya-devi His four-armed form of Narayana. Then Srivasa, Murari and other devotees, hearing in anxiety the news that the Lord would take sannyasa, came to Him, poured out their grief and asked to go with the Lord; Gaurasundara, giving them instruction in the truth, consoled them.1

Raga varadi, the "dhulakhela" tune

তবে দেবী শচীরাণী, কহে মন-কাহিনী,
হিয়া-দুঃখে বিরস-বদন ।
মুখে না নিঃসরে বাণী, দু-নয়ানে ঝরে পানী,
দেখি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া অচেতন ॥ ১ ॥

tabe debī śacīrāṇī, kahe mana-kāhinī,
hiẏā-duḥkhe birasa-badana |
mukhe nā niḥsare bāṇī, du-naẏāne jhare pānī,
dekhi' biṣṇupriẏā acetana || 1 ||

tabe devi shachi-rani — then queen Shachi-devi; kahe mana-kahini — [would] tell what is in her heart; hiya-duhkhe virasa-vadana — her face wan with grief; mukhe na nihsare vani — no word comes from her lips; du-nayane jhare pani — tears stream from both eyes; dekhi vishnupriya achetana — seeing this, Vishnupriya [falls] senseless

1Then queen Shachi-devi [wishes] to tell what is in her heart —
her face is wan with grief;
but no word comes from her lips, tears stream from her eyes —
seeing this, Vishnupriya fell senseless.

সুধাইতে নারে কথা, অন্তরে মরম-ব্যথা,
লোকমুখে শুনি' ঘানাঘুসা ।
ইঙ্গিতে বুঝিল কাজ, পড়িল অকাল-বাজ,
চেতন হরিল সেই দীনা ॥ ২ ॥

sudhāite nāre kathā, antare marama-byathā,
lokamukhe śuni' ghānāghusā |
iṅgite bujhila kāja, paṛila akāla-bāja,
cetana harila sei dīnā || 2 ||

sudhaite nare katha — she cannot ask; antare marama-vyatha — deep pain in her heart; loka-mukhe shuni ghanaghusa — having heard people's whispers; ingite bujhila kaja — by hints she understood the matter; padila akala-baja — an untimely thunderbolt fell; chetana harila sei dina — the poor one lost her senses

2She cannot ask; deep in her heart is pain;
she had heard people's whispers —
and by hints understood the matter: a thunderbolt fell out of season,
and the poor one lost her senses.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মনে গুণে, প্রভু দিন-অবসানে,
ঘরেতে আইলা ত্বরিতে ।
করিয়া ভোজন-পান, সুখে শয্যায় শয়ান,
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আইলা তুরিতে ॥ ৩ ॥

biṣṇupriẏā mane guṇe, prabhu dina-abasāne,
gharete āilā tbarite |
kariẏā bhojana-pāna, sukhe śayyāẏa śaẏāna,
biṣṇupriẏā āilā turite || 3 ||

vishnupriya mane gune — Vishnupriya ponders; prabhu dina-avasane — the Lord at day's end; gharete aila tvarite — came home quickly; kariya bhojana-pana — having eaten and drunk; sukhe shayyaya shayana — lies contentedly on the bed; vishnupriya aila turite — Vishnupriya came quickly

3Vishnupriya ponders in her heart. At the close of day the Lord
came home in haste;
having eaten and drunk, He lay down contentedly on His bed —
and Vishnupriya hurried [to Him].

চরণকমল-পাশে, নিঃশ্বাস ছাড়িয়া বৈসে,
নেহারয়ে কাতর-বয়ান ।
হৃদয়-উপরে থুঞা, বান্ধে ভুজলতা দিয়া,
প্রিয়-প্রাণনাথের চরণ ॥ ৪ ॥

caraṇakamala-pāśe, niḥśbāsa chāṛiẏā baise,
nehāraẏe kātara-baẏāna |
hṛdaẏa-upare thuñā, bāndhe bhujalatā diẏā,
priẏa-prāṇanāthera caraṇa || 4 ||

charana-kamala-pashe — by the lotus feet; nihshvasa chhadiya vaise — sighing, she sits; neharaye katara-bayana — gazes with a sorrowful face; hridaya-upare thuña — placing on her bosom; bandhe bhujalata diya — binds with creeper-arms; priya-prananathera charana — the feet of her beloved Lord of life

4Sighing, she sits by His lotus feet
and gazes [at Him] with a sorrowful face;
laying on her bosom the feet of her beloved Lord of life,
she binds them with her creeper-arms.

দু-নয়ানে বহে নীর, ভিজিল হিয়ার চীর,
চরণ বাহিয়া পড়ে ধারা ।
চেতন পাইয়া চিতে, উঠে প্রভু আচম্বিতে,
প্রিয়ায় পুছে অভিপারা ॥ ৫ ॥

du-naẏāne bahe nīra, bhijila hiẏāra cīra,
caraṇa bāhiẏā paṛe dhārā |
cetana pāiẏā cite, uṭhe prabhu ācambite,
priẏāẏa puche abhipārā || 5 ||

du-nayane vahe nira — tears flow from both eyes; bhijila hiyara chira — the cloth on her bosom is soaked; charana vahiya pade dhara — streams run down the feet; chetana paiya chite — feeling it; uthe prabhu achambite — the Lord suddenly rises; priyaya puchhe abhipara — asks His beloved what is wrong

5Tears flow from both her eyes, the cloth over her bosom is soaked,
streams run down [the Lord's] feet.
Feeling it, the Lord suddenly rises
and asks His beloved what is wrong.2

মোর প্রাণপ্রিয়া তুমি, কান্দ কি কারণে জানি,
কহ প্রিয়ে ইহার উত্তর ।
থুইয়া উরুর উপর, চিবুকে দক্ষিণ কর,
পুছে কিছু মধুর অক্ষর ॥ ৬ ॥

mora prāṇapriẏā tumi, kānda ki kāraṇe jāni,
kaha priẏe ihāra uttara |
thuiẏā urura upara, cibuke dakṣiṇa kara,
puche kichu madhura akṣara || 6 ||

mora prana-priya tumi — you are dear to Me as life; kanda ki karane jani — why do you weep, I want to know; kaha priye ihara uttara — answer, beloved; thuiya urura upara — setting on His lap; chibuke dakshina kara — right hand on her chin; puchhe kichhu madhura akshara — asks in sweet words

6"You are dear to Me as life — why do you weep? I want to know:
answer Me, beloved."
Setting her on His lap, taking her chin in His right hand,
He asks in sweet words.

কান্দে দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, বিদারিয়া যায় হিয়া,
পুছিতে না কহে কিছু বাণী ।
অন্তরে গুমরে প্রাণ, দেহে নাহি সম্বিধান,
নয়ানে ঝরয়ে মাত্র পানী ॥ ৭ ॥

kānde debī biṣṇupriẏā, bidāriẏā yāẏa hiẏā,
puchite nā kahe kichu bāṇī |
antare gumare prāṇa, dehe nāhi sambidhāna,
naẏāne jharaẏe mātra pānī || 7 ||

kande devi vishnupriya — Vishnupriya-devi weeps; bidariya yaya hiya — her heart bursts; puchhite na kahe kichhu vani — asked, she says no word; antare gumare prana — life smoulders within; dehe nahi samvidhana — the body is senseless; nayane jharaye matra pani — only tears stream from her eyes

7Vishnupriya-devi weeps, her heart is bursting;
when asked, she says not a word;
life smoulders within her, her body is senseless —
only tears stream from her eyes.

পুনঃ পুনঃ পুছে পহুঁ, সুমতি না দেই তভু,
কান্দে মাত্র চরণে ধরিয়া ।
প্রভু সব কলা জানে, পুছে নানা-বিধানে,
অঙ্গবাসে বয়ান মুছিয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

punaḥ punaḥ puche pahuṁ, sumati nā dei tabhu,
kānde mātra caraṇe dhariẏā |
prabhu saba kalā jāne, puche nānā-bidhāne,
aṅgabāse baẏāna muchiẏā || 8 ||

punah punah puchhe pahun — again and again the Lord asks; sumati na dei tabhu — still she gives no answer; kande matra charane dhariya — only weeps, clasping His feet; prabhu saba kala jane — the Lord knows every art; puchhe nana-vidhane — asks in many ways; anga-vase bayana muchhiya — wiping her face with His cloth

8Again and again the Lord asks — and still she does not answer,
but only weeps, clasping His feet.
The Lord, who knows every art, asks in many ways,
wiping her face with the edge of His cloth.

নানারঙ্গ পরথাব, করিয়া বাঢ়ায় ভাব,
যে কথায় পাষাণ মুঞ্জরে ।
প্রভুর ব্যগ্রতা দেখি', বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া চন্দ্রমুখী,
কহে কিছু গদ্গদ-স্বরে ॥ ৯ ॥

nānāraṅga parathāba, kariẏā bāṛhāẏa bhāba,
ye kathāẏa pāṣāṇa muñjare |
prabhura byagratā dekhi', biṣṇupriẏā candramukhī,
kahe kichu gadgada-sbare || 9 ||

nana-ranga parathava — playful talks of many kinds; kariya badhaya bhava — making them, He stirs feeling; ye kathaya pashana munjare — at such words a stone would blossom; prabhura vyagrata dekhi — seeing the Lord's eagerness; vishnupriya chandramukhi — moon-faced Vishnupriya; kahe kichhu gadgada-svare — speaks in a faltering voice

9He begins one playful talk after another, awakening feeling in her —
at such words even a stone would blossom.
Seeing the Lord's eagerness, moon-faced Vishnupriya
spoke in a faltering voice:

শুন শুন প্রাণনাথ, মোর শিরে দেহ হাত,
সন্ন্যাস করিবে নাকি তুমি ।
লোকমুখে শুনি' ইহা, বিদরিতে চাহে হিয়া,
আগুনিতে প্রবেশিব আমি ॥ ১০ ॥

śuna śuna prāṇanātha, mora śire deha hāta,
sannyāsa karibe nāki tumi |
lokamukhe śuni' ihā, bidarite cāhe hiẏā,
āgunite prabeśiba āmi || 10 ||

shuna shuna prananatha — listen, Lord of my life; mora shire deha hata — put Your hand on my head; sannyasa karibe naki tumi — will You really take sannyasa; loka-mukhe shuni iha — hearing this from people; bidarite chahe hiya — my heart would burst; agunite praveshiba ami — I shall enter fire

10"Listen, listen, Lord of my life, put Your hand on my head [and tell the truth]:
are You really going to take sannyasa?
Hearing it from people, I feel my heart will burst —
I shall enter fire.

তোমা লাগি' জীবন-ধন, রূপ নব যৌবন,
বেশ-বিলাস-ভাব-কলা ।
তুমি যবে ছাড়ি' যাবে, কি কাজ এ ছার জীবে,
হিয়া পোড়ে যেন বিষ-জ্বালা ॥ ১১ ॥

tomā lāgi' jībana-dhana, rūpa naba yaubana,
beśa-bilāsa-bhāba-kalā |
tumi yabe chāṛi' yābe, ki kāja e chāra jībe,
hiẏā poṛe yena biṣa-jbālā || 11 ||

toma lagi — for You; jivana-dhana — life and wealth; rupa nava yauvana — beauty, fresh youth; besha-vilasa-bhava-kala — dress, graces, feelings, arts; tumi yabe chhadi yabe — when You go away; ki kaja e chhara jive — what use this wretched life; hiya pode yena visha-jvala — the heart burns as with poison

11For You are my life and wealth, my beauty and youth,
my dress, my graces, feelings and arts;
when You go away, what use is this wretched life? —
my heart burns as with poison.

আমা হেন ভাগ্যবতী, নাহি কোন যুবতী,
তুমি মোর প্রিয় প্রাণনাথ ।
বড় প্রীতি আশা ছিল, নিজ দেহ সমর্পিল,
এ নব যৌবনে দিবা হাত ॥ ১১+১ ॥

āmā hena bhāgyabatī, nāhi kona yubatī,
tumi mora priẏa prāṇanātha |
baṛa prīti āśā chila, nija deha samarpila,
e naba yaubane dibā hāta || 11+1 ||

ama hena bhagyavati — as fortunate as I; nahi kona yuvati — there is no young woman; tumi mora priya prananatha — You are my beloved Lord of life; bada priti asha chhila — great were love and hope; nija deha samarpila — I gave myself; e nava yauvane diba hata — [that] You would give Your hand in this youth

11+1There is no other young woman as fortunate as I:3
You are my beloved Lord of life;
great were my love and hope — I gave myself to You,
[trusting] that You would give me Your hand in this youth.

ধিক্ রহু মোর দেহে, এক নিবেদিয়ে তোহে,
কেমনে হাঁটিয়া যাবে পথে ।
শিরীষ-কুসুম যেন, সুকোমল শ্রীচরণ,
পরশিতে ডর লাগে হাথে ॥ ১২ ॥

dhik rahu mora dehe, eka nibediẏe tohe,
kemane hāṁṭiẏā yābe pathe |
śirīṣa-kusuma yena, sukomala śrīcaraṇa,
paraśite ḍara lāge hāthe || 12 ||

dhik rahu mora dehe — shame on my body; eka nivediye tohe — one thing I ask You; kemane hantiya yabe pathe — how will You walk the roads; shirisha-kusuma yena — like shirisha flowers; sukomala sri-charana — the tender holy feet; parashite dara lage hathe — my hand fears to touch

12Shame on my body! One thing I ask You:
how will You walk the roads on foot?
Your feet are tender as shirisha flowers —
my hand is afraid to touch them.

ভূমিতে দাঁড়াও যবে, ডরে প্রাণ হালে তবে,
শিহরিয়া পড়য়ে সব গায় ।
অরণ্য-কণ্টক-বনে, কোথা যাবে কোন্ খানে,
কেমনে হাঁটিবে রাঙা পায় ॥ ১৩ ॥

bhūmite dāṁṛāo yabe, ḍare prāṇa hāle tabe,
śihariẏā paṛaẏe saba gāẏa |
araṇya-kaṇṭaka-bane, kothā yābe kon khāne,
kemane hāṁṭibe rāṅā pāẏa || 13 ||

bhumite danrao yabe — when You stand on the ground; dare prana hale tabe — then my heart quakes with fear; shihariya padaye saba gaya — my whole body shudders; aranya-kantaka-vane — in thorny forests; kotha yabe kon khane — where will You go, to what place; kemane hantibe ranga paya — how will You walk on crimson feet

13When You stand on the ground, my heart quakes with fear
and my whole body shudders;
in the forests, among thorns, where will You go, to what lands?
How will You walk on Your crimson feet?

সুধাময় মুখ-ইন্দু, তাহে ঘর্ম-বিন্দু বিন্দু,
অল্প আয়াস মাত্র দেখি ।
বরিষা-বাদল-বেলা, ক্ষণে বারি ক্ষণে খরা,
সন্ন্যাসে করয়ে মহাদুখী ॥ ১৪ ॥

sudhāmaẏa mukha-indu, tāhe gharma-bindu bindu,
alpa āẏāsa mātra dekhi |
bariṣā-bādala-belā, kṣaṇe bāri kṣaṇe kharā,
sannyāse karaẏe mahādukhī || 14 ||

sudhamaya mukha-indu — the nectarean moon-face; tahe gharma-bindu bindu — drops of sweat on it; alpa ayasa matra dekhi — I see at the slightest effort; barisha-badala-bela — in the rainy season; kshane vari kshane khara — now rain, now heat; sannyase karaye mahadukhi — sannyasa makes one suffer greatly

14On Your nectar moon-face drops of sweat appear
at the slightest effort;
in the rainy season — now downpour, now scorching heat:
sannyasa will bring [You] great suffering.

তোমার চরণ বিনি, আর কিছু নাহি জানি,
আমারে ফেলিহ কার ঠাঁয়ে ।
ধর্ম-ভয় নাহি তোরা, শচী বৃদ্ধা আধমরা,
কেমনে ছাড়িবে হেন মায়ে ॥ ১৫ ॥

tomāra caraṇa bini, āra kichu nāhi jāni,
āmāre pheliha kāra ṭhāṁẏe |
dharma-bhaẏa nāhi torā, śacī bṛddhā ādhamarā,
kemane chāṛibe hena māẏe || 15 ||

tomara charana vini — apart from Your feet; ara kichhu nahi jani — I know nothing else; amare pheliha kara thaye — to whom will You leave me; dharma-bhaya nahi tora — You have no fear of [breaking] dharma; shachi vriddha adhamara — Shachi is old, half-dead; kemane chhadibe hena maye — how will You leave such a mother

15Apart from Your feet I know nothing —
to whom will You leave me?
Have You no fear of [breaking] dharma? Shachi is old and half-dead —
how will You leave such a mother?

মুরারি-মুকুন্দ-দত্ত, হেন সব ভকত,
শ্রীনিবাস আর হরিদাস ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আদি, ছাড়িয়া কি কার্য সাধি',
কেমনে বা করিবে সন্ন্যাস ॥ ১৬ ॥

murāri-mukunda-datta, hena saba bhakata,
śrīnibāsa āra haridāsa |
adbaita-ācārya ādi, chāṛiẏā ki kārya sādhi',
kemane bā karibe sannyāsa || 16 ||

murari-mukunda-datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; hena saba bhakata — such devotees; srinivasa ara haridasa — Srinivasa and Haridasa; advaita-acharya adi — Advaita Acharya and others; chhadiya ki karya sadhi — leaving them, what will You achieve; kemane va karibe sannyasa — how will You take sannyasa

16Murari, Mukunda Datta — such devotees,
Srinivasa and Haridasa,
Advaita Acharya and the others — leaving them, what will You achieve?
How can You take sannyasa?

তুমি প্রভু প্রেমরাশি, জগজনে হেন বাসি,
বিপরীত চরিত আশয় ।
তুমি দেশান্তরে যাবে, শুনিলে মরিবে সবে,
হবে সব অপযশময় ॥ ১৭ ॥

tumi prabhu premarāśi, jagajane hena bāsi,
biparīta carita āśaẏa |
tumi deśāntare yābe, śunile maribe sabe,
habe saba apayaśamaẏa || 17 ||

tumi prabhu prema-rashi — You, Lord, are a treasury of prema; jagajane hena basi — so the world thinks; viparita charita ashaya — Your deeds and intent are contrary; tumi deshantare yabe — You will go to far lands; shunile maribe sabe — hearing it, all will die; habe saba apayashamaya — all will be full of disgrace

17You, Lord, are a treasury of prema — so the whole world thinks —
yet Your deeds and intentions are the opposite.
You will go to far lands — hearing it, everyone will die,
and all will be covered with disgrace.

কি কহিব মুঞি ছার, মূল তোমার সংসার,
সন্ন্যাস করিবে মোর ডরে ।
তোমার নিছনি লঞা, মরি যাঙ বিষ খাঞা,
সুখে নিবসহ নিজঘরে ॥ ১৮ ॥

ki kahiba muñi chāra, mūla tomāra saṃsāra,
sannyāsa karibe mora ḍare |
tomāra nichani lañā, mari yāṅa biṣa khāñā,
sukhe nibasaha nijaghare || 18 ||

ki kahiba munni chhara — what shall I, worthless, say; mula tomara samsara — [if I am] the root of Your household; sannyasa karibe mora dare — You will take sannyasa because of me; tomara nichhani lana — taking Your misfortunes on myself; mari yana visha khana — let me die by taking poison; sukhe nivasaha nijaghare — live happily in Your home

18What shall I, worthless one, say? If I am the root of Your household life
and You take sannyasa because of me —
let me take Your misfortunes upon myself and die by taking poison,4
and You live happily in Your own home.

প্রভু না যাইহ দেশান্তরে, কেহো নাহি এ সংসারে,
বদন চাহিতে পোড়ে হিয়া ।
কহিতে না পারে কথা, অন্তরে মরম-ব্যথা,
কান্দে মাত্র চরণে ধরিয়া ॥ ১৯ ॥

prabhu nā yāiha deśāntare, keho nāhi e saṃsāre,
badana cāhite poṛe hiẏā |
kahite nā pāre kathā, antare marama-byathā,
kānde mātra caraṇe dhariẏā || 19 ||

prabhu na yaiha deshantare — Lord, do not go to far lands; keho nahi e samsare — I have no one in this world; vadana chahite pode hiya — looking at Your face my heart burns; kahite na pare katha — she can say no word; antare marama-vyatha — pain in her heart; kande matra charane dhariya — only weeps, clasping His feet

19Lord, do not go to far lands: I have no one in this world;
when I look at Your face my heart burns."
She can say no more — deep in her heart is pain;
she only weeps, clasping His feet.

শুনি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-বাণী, তবে সেই গৌরমণি,
হাসিয়া তুলিয়া নিল কোলে ।
বসনে মুছিয়া মুখ, করে নানা কৌতুক,
মিছা দুঃখ না ভাবিহ বোলে ॥ ২০ ॥

śuni' biṣṇupriẏā-bāṇī, tabe sei gauramaṇi,
hāsiẏā tuliẏā nila kole |
basane muchiẏā mukha, kare nānā kautuka,
michā duḥkha nā bhābiha bole || 20 ||

shuni vishnupriya-vani — hearing Vishnupriya's words; tabe sei gauramani — then that jewel Gaura; hasiya tuliya nila kole — smiling, took her on His lap; vasane muchhiya mukha — wiping her face with His cloth; kare nana kautuka — jests in many ways; michha duhkha na bhaviha bole — says, "do not dwell on needless grief"

20Hearing Vishnupriya's words, then that jewel Gauranga
smiling, took her onto His lap;
wiping her face with His cloth, He jests in many ways
and says: "Do not dwell on needless grief.

আমি তোরে ছাড়িয়া, সন্ন্যাস করিব গিয়া,
এ কথা বা কে কহিল তোকে ।
যে করি সে করি যবে, তোমারে কহিব তবে,
এখনে না মর মিছা-শোকে ॥ ২১ ॥

āmi tore chāṛiẏā, sannyāsa kariba giẏā,
e kathā bā ke kahila toke |
ye kari se kari yabe, tomāre kahiba tabe,
ekhane nā mara michā-śoke || 21 ||

ami tore chhadiya — that I, leaving you; sannyasa kariba giya — will go and take sannyasa; e katha va ke kahila toke — who told you this; ye kari se kari yabe — whatever I do, when I do it; tomare kahiba tabe — I shall tell you then; ekhane na mara michha-shoke — now do not die of needless sorrow

21That I will leave you and go to take sannyasa —
who ever told you that?
Whatever I do, when I do it, I shall tell you then —
but now do not die of needless sorrow."

ইহা বলি' গৌরহরি, আশ্লেষ-চুম্বন করি',
নানা রস-কৌতুক-বিহারে ।
অনন্ত বিনোদ প্রেমা, লীলা-লাবণ্যের সীমা,
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া তুষিল প্রকারে ॥ ২২ ॥

ihā bali' gaurahari, āśleṣa-cumbana kari',
nānā rasa-kautuka-bihāre |
ananta binoda premā, līlā-lābaṇyera sīmā,
biṣṇupriẏā tuṣila prakāre || 22 ||

iha bali gaurahari — saying this, Gaurahari; ashlesha-chumbana kari — embracing and kissing; nana rasa-kautuka-vihare — in many sweet playful pastimes; ananta vinoda prema — endless the delights of His prema; lila-lavanyera sima — the limit of grace in lila; vishnupriya tushila prakare — comforted Vishnupriya in every way

22Saying this, Gaurahari embraces and kisses her
in many sweet and playful pastimes;
endless are the delights of His prema, He is the limit of grace in lila —
so in every way He comforted Vishnupriya.5

বিনোদ-বিলাস-রসে, ভৈ গেল রজনী-শেষে,
পুনঃ কিছু পুছে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
হিয়ায় আগুনি আছে, তে-কারণে পুনঃ পুছে,
প্রিয়-প্রাণনাথ-মুখ চাঞা ॥ ২৩ ॥

binoda-bilāsa-rase, bhai gela rajanī-śeṣe,
punaḥ kichu puche biṣṇupriẏā |
hiẏāẏa āguni āche, te-kāraṇe punaḥ puche,
priẏa-prāṇanātha-mukha cāñā || 23 ||

vinoda-vilasa-rase — in joyful play; bhai gela rajani-sheshe — the night came to an end; punah kichhu puchhe vishnupriya — Vishnupriya asks again; hiyaya aguni achhe — there is fire in her heart; te-karane punah puchhe — therefore she asks again; priya-prananatha-mukha chaña — gazing at her beloved Lord's face

23In joyful play the night came to an end,
and Vishnupriya asks again:
there is fire in her heart — that is why she asks again,
gazing at the face of her beloved Lord of life.

প্রভু-কর বুকে দিয়া, পুছে দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া,
মিছা না কহিও মোর ডরে ।
হেন অনুমান করি, যত কহ সে চাতুরী,
পলাইবে মোর অগোচরে ॥ ২৪ ॥

prabhu-kara buke diẏā, puche debī biṣṇupriẏā,
michā nā kahio mora ḍare |
hena anumāna kari, yata kaha se cāturī,
palāibe mora agocare || 24 ||

prabhu-kara buke diya — pressing the Lord's hand to her breast; puchhe devi vishnupriya — Vishnupriya-devi asks; michha na kahio mora dare — do not lie for fear of me; hena anumana kari — so I suspect; yata kaha se chaturi — all You say is playfulness; palaibe mora agochare — You will flee without my knowing

24Pressing the Lord's hand to her breast, Vishnupriya-devi asks:
"Do not lie to me for fear of me.
This is what I think: all You say is mere playfulness —
You will run away without my knowing.

তুমি নিজবশ প্রভু, পরবশ নহ কভু,
যে করহ আপনার সুখে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিবে তুমি, কি বলিতে পারি আমি,
নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহ মোকে ॥ ২৫ ॥

tumi nijabaśa prabhu, parabaśa naha kabhu,
ye karaha āpanāra sukhe |
sannyāsa karibe tumi, ki balite pāri āmi,
niścaẏa kariẏā kaha moke || 25 ||

tumi nijavasha prabhu — You, Lord, are Your own master; paravasha naha kabhu — never in another's power; ye karaha apanara sukhe — You do what pleases You; sannyasa karibe tumi — if You take sannyasa; ki balite pari ami — what can I say; nishchaya kariya kaha moke — tell me truly

25You, Lord, are Your own master, never in another's power,
and You do what pleases You.
If You will take sannyasa — what can I say?
[Only] tell me the truth."

এ বোল শুনিঞা পহুঁ, মুচকি হাসিয়া লহুঁ,
কহে শুন মোর প্রিয়-প্রিয়া ।
কিছু না করিহ চিতে, যে কহিয়ে তোর হিতে,
সাবধানে শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ২৬ ॥

e bola śuniñā pahuṁ, mucaki hāsiẏā lahuṁ,
kahe śuna mora priẏa-priẏā |
kichu nā kariha cite, ye kahiẏe tora hite,
sābadhāne śuna mana diẏā || 26 ||

e bola shuniña pahun — hearing these words, the Lord; muchaki hasiya lahun — smiling softly; kahe shuna mora priya-priya — says: listen, My beloved; kichhu na kariha chite — do not grieve at heart; ye kahiye tora hite — what I say for your good; savadhane shuna mana diya — listen attentively

26Hearing these words, the Lord smiled softly
and says: "Listen, My beloved,
do not grieve at all in your heart: what I say for your good
listen to attentively.

জগতে যতেক দেখ, মিছা করি' সব লেখ,
সত্য এক সবে ভগবান্ ।
সত্য আর বৈষ্ণব, তা-বিনে যতেক সব,
মিছা করি' করহ গেয়ান ॥ ২৭ ॥

jagate yateka dekha, michā kari' saba lekha,
satya eka sabe bhagabān |
satya āra baiṣṇaba, tā-bine yateka saba,
michā kari' karaha geẏāna || 27 ||

jagate yateka dekha — all you see in the world; michha kari saba lekha — count as empty; satya eka sabe bhagavan — Bhagavan alone is true; satya ara vaishnava — true also the Vaishnavas; ta-vine yateka saba — all else besides; michha kari karaha geyana — regard as empty

27All that you see in the world count as empty:
Bhagavan alone is true,
and true are the Vaishnavas; all else besides them
count as empty.6

মিছা সুত, পতি, নারী, পিতা মাতা যত বলি,
পরিণামে কেবা বা কাহার ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ বহি, আর ত কুটুম্ব নাহি,
যত দেখ এ মায়া তাঁহার ॥ ২৮ ॥

michā suta, pati, nārī, pitā mātā yata bali,
pariṇāme kebā bā kāhāra |
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa bahi, āra ta kuṭumba nāhi,
yata dekha e māẏā tāṁhāra || 28 ||

michha suta, pati, nari — empty are son, husband, wife; pita mata yata bali — father, mother — all so called; pariname keba va kahara — in the end who is whose; sri-krishna-charana vahi — apart from Sri Krishna's feet; ara ta kutumba nahi — there is no other kin; yata dekha e maya tanhara — all you see is His maya

28Empty are son, husband, wife, father, mother — all that goes by such names:
in the end, who belongs to whom?
Apart from Sri Krishna's feet there is no other kin;
all that you see is His maya.

কিবা নারী, পুরুষ দেখ, সভারি সে আত্মা এক,
মিছা মায়াবন্ধে ভাবে দুই ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ সভার পতি, আর সব প্রকৃতি,
এই কথা না বুঝয়ে কোই ॥ ২৯ ॥

kibā nārī, puruṣa dekha, sabhāri se ātmā eka,
michā māẏābandhe bhābe dui |
śrīkṛṣṇa sabhāra pati, āra saba prakṛti,
ei kathā nā bujhaẏe koi || 29 ||

kiba nari, purusha dekha — whether woman or man, see; sabhari se atma eka — the soul of all is one [in nature]; michha maya-bandhe bhave dui — falsely, in maya's bonds, one thinks "two"; sri-krishna sabhara pati — Sri Krishna is the husband of all; ara saba prakriti — all others are prakriti; ei katha na bujhaye koi — this no one understands

29Whether woman or man — see: the soul of all is one [in nature];
only in the bonds of maya does one imagine 'two'.
Sri Krishna is the husband of all, and all others are prakriti:
this no one understands.7

রক্ত-রেতঃ-সম্মিলনে, জন্ম বিষ্ঠা-মূত্র-স্থানে,
ভূমে পড়ে হঞা অগেয়ান ।
বাল, যুবা, বৃদ্ধ হঞা, নানা দুঃখে কষ্ট পাঞা,
দেহে গেহে করে অভিমান ॥ ৩০ ॥

rakta-retaḥ-sammilane, janma biṣṭhā-mūtra-sthāne,
bhūme paṛe hañā ageẏāna |
bāla, yubā, bṛddha hañā, nānā duḥkhe kaṣṭa pāñā,
dehe gehe kare abhimāna || 30 ||

rakta-retah-sammilane — from the union of blood and seed; janma vishtha-mutra-sthane — birth in a place of filth; bhume pade hana ageyana — falls to the ground unknowing; bala, yuva, vriddha hana — as child, youth, old man; nana duhkhe kashta pana — suffering many miseries; dehe gehe kare abhimana — takes pride in body and home

30From the union of blood and seed a person is born in a place of filth
and falls to the ground knowing nothing;
as a child, a youth, an old man, he suffers many miseries —
and takes pride in his body and home.

বন্ধু করি' যারে পালি, তারা সব দেই গালি,
অভিমানে বৃদ্ধকাল বঞ্চে ।
শ্রবণ নয়ান আন্ধে, বিষাদ ভাবিয়া কান্দে,
তভু নাহি ভজয়ে গোবিন্দে ॥ ৩১ ॥

bandhu kari' yāre pāli, tārā saba dei gāli,
abhimāne bṛddhakāla bañce |
śrabaṇa naẏāna āndhe, biṣāda bhābiẏā kānde,
tabhu nāhi bhajaẏe gobinde || 31 ||

bandhu kari yare pali — those he raised as his own; tara saba dei gali — they all revile him; abhimane vriddha-kala vanche — in pride he spends old age; shravana nayana andhe — hearing and sight grow dim; vishada bhaviya kande — he weeps thinking of his woes; tabhu nahi bhajaye govinde — still he does not serve Govinda

31Those he raised as his own all revile him;
in pride he lives out his old age;
hearing and sight grow dim, he weeps thinking of his woes —
and still he does not serve Govinda.

কৃষ্ণ ভজিবার তরে, দেহ ধরি' এ সংসারে,
মায়াবন্ধে পাশরে আপনা ।
অহঙ্কারে মত্ত হঞা, নিজপ্রভু পাশরিয়া,
শেষে মরে নরক-যন্ত্রণা ॥ ৩২ ॥

kṛṣṇa bhajibāra tare, deha dhari' e saṃsāre,
māẏābandhe pāśare āpanā |
ahaṅkāre matta hañā, nijaprabhu pāśariẏā,
śeṣe mare naraka-yantraṇā || 32 ||

krishna bhajibara tare — in order to serve Krishna; deha dhari e samsare — taking a body in this world; maya-bandhe pashare apana — in maya's bonds forgets himself; ahamkare matta hana — drunk with conceit; nija-prabhu pashariya — forgetting his own Lord; sheshe mare naraka-yantrana — in the end dies in hell's torments

32He took a body in this world in order to serve Krishna —
yet in the bonds of maya he forgets himself;
drunk with conceit, forgetting his own Lord,
in the end he dies in the torments of hell.

তোর নাম বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, সার্থক করহ ইহা,
মিছা শোক না করিহ চিতে ।
এ তোরে কহিলুঁ কথা, দূর কর আন-চিন্তা,
মন দেহ কৃষ্ণের চরিতে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

tora nāma biṣṇupriẏā, sārthaka karaha ihā,
michā śoka nā kariha cite |
e tore kahiluṁ kathā, dūra kara āna-cintā,
mana deha kṛṣṇera carite || 33 ||

tora nama vishnupriya — your name is Vishnupriya; sarthaka karaha iha — make it meaningful; michha shoka na kariha chite — keep no needless grief at heart; e tore kahilun katha — I have told you this; dura kara ana-chinta — put away other thoughts; mana deha krishnera charite — give your mind to Krishna's deeds

33Your name is Vishnupriya ('dear to Vishnu'): make it meaningful,
do not keep needless grief in your heart.
I have told you this — put away other thoughts
and give your mind to the deeds of Krishna."

আপনে ঈশ্বর হঞা, দূর করে নিজ-মায়া,
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া পরসন্ন-চিত ।
দূরে গেল দুঃখ-শোক, আনন্দে ভরল বুক,
চতুর্ভুজ দেখে আচম্বিত ॥ ৩৪ ॥

āpane īśbara hañā, dūra kare nija-māẏā,
biṣṇupriẏā parasanna-cita |
dūre gela duḥkha-śoka, ānande bharala buka,
caturbhuja dekhe ācambita || 34 ||

apane ishvara hana — being Himself the Lord; dura kare nija-maya — removes His own maya; vishnupriya parasanna-chita — Vishnupriya's heart grew clear; dure gela duhkha-shoka — grief and sorrow went away; anande bharala buka — her breast filled with joy; chaturbhuja dekhe achambita — suddenly she sees the four-armed form

34Being Himself the Lord, He removed His own maya,8 —
and Vishnupriya's heart grew clear:
grief and sorrow went away, her breast filled with joy —
and suddenly she sees [Him] four-armed.

তবে দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, চতুর্ভুজ দেখিয়া,
পতিবুদ্ধি নাহি ছাড়ে তভু ।
পড়িয়া চরণতলে, প্রণতি মিনতি করে,
এক নিবেদন শুন প্রভু ॥ ৩৫ ॥

tabe debī biṣṇupriẏā, caturbhuja dekhiẏā,
patibuddhi nāhi chāṛe tabhu |
paṛiẏā caraṇatale, praṇati minati kare,
eka nibedana śuna prabhu || 35 ||

tabe devi vishnupriya — then Vishnupriya-devi; chaturbhuja dekhiya — seeing the four-armed form; pati-buddhi nahi chhade tabhu — still does not give up thinking of Him as husband; padiya charana-tale — falling at His feet; pranati minati kare — bows and pleads; eka nivedana shuna prabhu — hear, Lord, one request

35Yet even seeing the four-armed form,
Vishnupriya-devi does not give up thinking of Him as her husband;
falling at His feet, she bows and pleads:
"Hear, Lord, one request of mine.

মো অতি অধম ছার, জনমিলুঁ এ সংসার,
তুমি মোর প্রিয় প্রাণপতি ।
এহেন সম্পদ মোর, দাসী হৈয়াছিলুঁ তোর,
কি লাগিয়া ভেল অধোগতি ॥ ৩৬ ॥

mo ati adhama chāra, janamiluṁ e saṃsāra,
tumi mora priẏa prāṇapati |
ehena sampada mora, dāsī haiẏāchiluṁ tora,
ki lāgiẏā bhela adhogati || 36 ||

mo ati adhama chhara — I, the lowest and worthless; janamilun e samsara — was born in this world; tumi mora priya pranapati — You are my beloved husband, Lord of my life; ehena sampada mora — such was my fortune; dasi haiyachhilun tora — I had become Your maidservant; ki lagiya bhela adhogati — why such a fall

36I, the lowest and most worthless, was born in this world,
and You are my beloved husband, the Lord of my life;
such was my good fortune — I had become Your maidservant —
why then [now] such a fall?"

ইহা বলি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, কান্দে উতরোলি হঞা,
অধিক বাড়ল পরমাদ ।
প্রিয়জন-আর্তি দেখি', ছল ছল করে আঁখি,
কোলে করি' করিলা প্রসাদ ॥ ৩৭ ॥

ihā bali' biṣṇupriẏā, kānde utaroli hañā,
adhika bāṛala paramāda |
priẏajana-ārti dekhi', chala chala kare āṁkhi,
kole kari' karilā prasāda || 37 ||

iha bali vishnupriya — saying this, Vishnupriya; kande utaroli hana — weeps aloud; adhika badala paramada — the distress grew greater; priyajana-arti dekhi — seeing His beloved's anguish; chhala chhala kare ankhi — His eyes brim with tears; kole kari karila prasada — taking her in His arms, He bestowed grace

37Saying this, Vishnupriya wept aloud,
and her distress grew greater still.
Seeing His beloved's anguish, the Lord, His eyes brimming with tears,
took her in His arms and bestowed His grace:

শুন দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, এ তোরে কহিল ইহা,
যখনে যে তুমি মনে কর ।
আমি যথা তথা যাই, আছিয়ে তোমার ঠাঁই,
সত্য সত্য কহিলাম দঢ় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

śuna debī biṣṇupriẏā, e tore kahila ihā,
yakhane ye tumi mane kara |
āmi yathā tathā yāi, āchiẏe tomāra ṭhāṁi,
satya satya kahilāma daṛha || 38 ||

shuna devi vishnupriya — listen, Vishnupriya-devi; e tore kahila iha — this I tell you; yakhane ye tumi mane kara — whenever you think [of Me]; ami yatha tatha yai — wherever I go; achhiye tomara thai — I am with you; satya satya kahilama dadha — truly, truly I say firmly

38"Listen, Vishnupriya-devi, this is what I tell you:
whenever you think of Me —
wherever I may go, I am with you;
truly, truly I tell you firmly."9

কৃষ্ণ-আজ্ঞাবাণী শুনি', বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মনে গুণি',
স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর এই প্রভু ।
নিজসুখে করে কাজ, কে দিবে তাহাতে বাধ,
প্রত্যুত্তর না দিলেক তভু ॥ ৩৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa-ājñābāṇī śuni', biṣṇupriẏā mane guṇi',
sbatantra īśbara ei prabhu |
nijasukhe kare kāja, ke dibe tāhāte bādha,
pratyuttara nā dileka tabhu || 39 ||

krishna-ajna-vani shuni — hearing Krishna's word of command; vishnupriya mane guni — Vishnupriya thought; svatantra ishvara ei prabhu — this Lord is the independent Master; nija-sukhe kare kaja — He does as He pleases; ke dibe tahate badha — who will hinder Him; pratyuttara na dileka tabhu — and she gave no reply

39Hearing the word of Krishna's command, Vishnupriya thought:
"This Lord is the independent Master,
He does what pleases Him — who can stand in His way?" —
and she made no reply.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া হেঁটমুখী, ছল ছল করে আঁখি,
দেখি' প্রভু সরস সম্ভাষে ।
প্রভু-আচরণ-কথা, শুনিতে লাগয়ে ব্যথা,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ৪০ ॥

biṣṇupriẏā heṁṭamukhī, chala chala kare āṁkhi,
dekhi' prabhu sarasa sambhāṣe |
prabhu-ācaraṇa-kathā, śunite lāgaẏe byathā,
guṇa gāẏa e locanadāse || 40 ||

vishnupriya hentamukhi — Vishnupriya with lowered face; chhala chhala kare ankhi — her eyes brimming; dekhi prabhu sarasa sambhashe — seeing this, the Lord speaks tenderly; prabhu-acharana-katha — the account of the Lord's deeds; shunite lagaye vyatha — is painful to hear; guna gaya e lochanadase — this Lochana Dasa sings the qualities

40Vishnupriya lowered her face, her eyes brimming with tears;
seeing this, the Lord speaks tender words to her.
It is painful to hear of the Lord's deeds —
this Lochana Dasa sings of [His] qualities.

Raga varadi; disha: "My life, O moon of the twice-born! The sweetness of the form of Gora, who enchants Madana, ever wakes [in my heart] — I would take that form's misfortunes on myself and die"

এইমনে অনুমানে দিন-রাত্রি যায় ।
আগুনি জ্বলিল যেন সভার হিয়ায় ॥ ৪১ ॥

eimane anumāne dina-rātri yāẏa |
āguni jbalila yena sabhāra hiẏāẏa || 41 ||

eimane anumane — thus, in surmises; dina-ratri yaya — days and nights pass; aguni jvalila yena — as if fire flared up; sabhara hiyaya — in everyone's heart

41Thus, in surmises, days and nights go by —
as if a fire had flared up in everyone's heart.

সকল ভকতগণ একত্র হইয়া ।
গোরা-গুণগাথা কহে মরমে কান্দিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

sakala bhakatagaṇa ekatra haiẏā |
gorā-guṇagāthā kahe marame kāndiẏā || 42 ||

sakala bhakatagana — all the devotees; ekatra haiya — gathering together; gora-guna-gatha kahe — speak of Gora's qualities; marame kandiya — weeping in their souls

42All the devotees, gathering together,
speak of Gora's qualities, weeping in the depths of their souls.

শচী, বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া দোঁহে কান্দে দিবানিশি ।
দশদিক্ অন্ধকার, শূন্য হেন বাসি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

śacī, biṣṇupriẏā doṁhe kānde dibāniśi |
daśadik andhakāra, śūnya hena bāsi || 43 ||

shachi, vishnupriya donhe — Shachi and Vishnupriya both; kande divanishi — weep day and night; dashadik andhakara — darkness in all directions; shunya hena basi — all seems empty

43Shachi and Vishnupriya both weep day and night:
darkness on every side, all seems empty.

পুরজন পরিজন সোয়াথ না পায় ।
ছটফট করি' সব নগরে বেড়ায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

purajana parijana soẏātha nā pāẏa |
chaṭaphaṭa kari' saba nagare beṛāẏa || 44 ||

purajana parijana — townsfolk and household; soyatha na paya — find no peace; chhataphata kari — restlessly; saba nagare bedaya — all wander about the town

44Townsfolk and household find no peace:
all wander restlessly about the town.

হেনই সময়ে শ্রীনিবাস দ্বিজরায় ।
কাতর-হৃদয়ে কিছু প্রভুরে শুধায় ॥ ৪৫ ॥

henai samaẏe śrīnibāsa dbijarāẏa |
kātara-hṛdaẏe kichu prabhure śudhāẏa || 45 ||

henai samaye — at this time; srinivasa dvijaraya — Srinivasa, king of brahmanas; katara-hridaye — with an aching heart; kichhu prabhure shudhaya — asks the Lord

45At this time Srinivasa, king of brahmanas,
with an aching heart asks the Lord:

এক নিবেদন আছে — কহিতে ডরাঙ ।
আজ্ঞা পাইলে প্রভু-সঙ্গে মুঞি চলি যাঙ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

eka nibedana āche — kahite ḍarāṅa |
ājñā pāile prabhu-saṅge muñi cali yāṅa || 46 ||

eka nivedana achhe — I have one request; kahite daranga — I fear to say it; ajna paile — if I get leave; prabhu-sange munni chali yanga — I shall go with the Lord

46"I have one request — I am afraid to say it:
if You permit, Lord, I shall go with You.

আর যে বা পারে সেহ সঙ্গে চলি যাউ ।
তোমা না দেখিলে কেহো না রাখিবে জীউ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

āra ye bā pāre seha saṅge cali yāu |
tomā nā dekhile keho nā rākhibe jīu || 47 ||

ara ye va pare — and whoever else can; seha sange chali yau — let him go too; toma na dekhile — not seeing You; keho na rakhibe jiu — no one will keep alive

47And whoever else can — let him go with You too:
not seeing You, no one will stay alive.

আগে ত মরিব আমি — শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
আপন-অন্তর-কথা কহিল গোচর ॥ ৪৮ ॥

āge ta mariba āmi — śuna biśbambhara |
āpana-antara-kathā kahila gocara || 48 ||

age ta mariba ami — I shall die first; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; apana-antara-katha — what was in his heart; kahila gochara — he laid open

48I shall die first, listen, Vishvambhara" —
and he laid open to [the Lord] what was in his heart.

এ বোল শুনিঞা পহুঁ লহু লহু হাস ।
যে কিছু কহিয়ে তাহা শুন শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৪৯ ॥

e bola śuniñā pahuṁ lahu lahu hāsa |
ye kichu kahiẏe tāhā śuna śrīnibāsa || 49 ||

e bola shuniña — hearing this; pahun lahu lahu hasa — the Lord laughs softly; ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; taha shuna srinivasa — listen to it, Srinivasa

49Hearing this, the Lord laughed softly:
"Listen, Srinivasa, to what I say.

আমার বিচ্ছেদ লাগি' না পাবে তরাস ।
কভু না ছাড়িব আমি তোমা-সভার পাশ ॥ ৫০ ॥

āmāra biccheda lāgi' nā pābe tarāsa |
kabhu nā chāṛiba āmi tomā-sabhāra pāśa || 50 ||

amara vichchheda lagi — on account of separation from Me; na pabe tarasa — have no fear; kabhu na chhadiba ami — I shall never leave; toma-sabhara pasha — the company of you all

50Do not fear separation from Me:
I shall never leave you all.

বিশেষে তোমার ঘরে কৃষ্ণের মন্দিরে ।
নিরন্তর আছি আমি — মন কর স্থিরে ॥ ৫১ ॥

biśeṣe tomāra ghare kṛṣṇera mandire |
nirantara āchi āmi — mana kara sthire || 51 ||

visheshe — especially; tomara ghare — in your house; krishnera mandire — in Krishna's shrine; nirantara achhi ami — I abide always; mana kara sthire — set your mind at rest

51And especially in your house, in Krishna's shrine,
I abide always: set your mind at rest."10

প্রবোধ-বচন বলি' তুষিল তাহারে ।
মুরারিগুপ্তের ঘরে গেলা সন্ধ্যাকালে ॥ ৫২ ॥

prabodha-bacana bali' tuṣila tāhāre |
murāriguptera ghare gelā sandhyākāle || 52 ||

prabodha-bachana bali — speaking words of comfort; tushila tahare — He cheered him; murari-guptera ghare — to Murari Gupta's house; gela sandhya-kale — He went in the evening

52Having cheered him with words of comfort,
in the evening He went to the house of Murari Gupta.

হরিদাস সঙ্গে করি' মুরারি-মন্দিরে ।
নিভৃতে কহয়ে তারে দেবতার ঘরে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

haridāsa saṅge kari' murāri-mandire |
nibhṛte kahaẏe tāre debatāra ghare || 53 ||

haridasa sange kari — taking Haridasa along; murari-mandire — in Murari's house; nibhrite kahaye tare — speaks to him in private; devatara ghare — in the Deity's room

53Taking Haridasa with Him, [He came] to Murari's house
and speaks to him in private in the Deity's room:

শুনহ মুরারি তুমি আমার বচন ।
মোর প্রিয়-প্রাণ তুমি — কহি তে-কারণ ॥ ৫৪ ॥

śunaha murāri tumi āmāra bacana |
mora priẏa-prāṇa tumi — kahi te-kāraṇa || 54 ||

shunaha murari — listen, Murari; tumi amara bachana — to My words; mora priya-prana tumi — you are dear to Me as life; kahi te-karana — therefore I speak

54"Listen, Murari, to My words:
you are dear to Me as life — that is why I speak.

কহিব উত্তম কথা, শুন সাবধানে ।
উপদেশ কহি তোর হিতের কারণে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

kahiba uttama kathā, śuna sābadhāne |
upadeśa kahi tora hitera kāraṇe || 55 ||

kahiba uttama katha — I shall say something excellent; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; upadesha kahi — I give instruction; tora hitera karane — for your good

55I shall tell you something excellent — listen attentively:
I give you this instruction for your own good.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য গোসাঞি ত্রিজগতে ধন্য ।
তাহা-অধিক বন্ধু মোর নাহি আর অন্য ॥ ৫৬ ॥

adbaita-ācārya gosāñi trijagate dhanya |
tāhā-adhika bandhu mora nāhi āra anya || 56 ||

advaita-acharya gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; trijagate dhanya — is blessed in the three worlds; taha-adhika bandhu mora — a friend dearer than He; nahi ara anya — I have no other

56Advaita Acharya Gosani is blessed in the three worlds;
I have no other friend closer than He.

আপনে ঈশ্বর-অংশ — অখিলের গুরু ।
যে চাহে আপনা হিত তাঁর সেবা করু ॥ ৫৭ ॥

āpane īśbara-aṃśa — akhilera guru |
ye cāhe āpanā hita tāṁra sebā karu || 57 ||

apane ishvara-amsha — He Himself is a part of the Lord; akhilera guru — the guru of all; ye chahe apana hita — whoever wants his own good; tanra seva karu — let him serve Him

57He Himself is a part of the Lord, the guru of all:11
whoever wishes his own good, let him serve Him.

জগতের হিত সেই বৈষ্ণবের রাজা ।
পরম ভকতি করি' করহ তাঁর পূজা ॥ ৫৮ ॥

jagatera hita sei baiṣṇabera rājā |
parama bhakati kari' karaha tāṁra pūjā || 58 ||

jagatera hita sei — He is the good of the world; vaishnavera raja — the king of Vaishnavas; parama bhakati kari — with highest devotion; karaha tanra puja — worship Him

58He is the benefactor of the world, the king of Vaishnavas:
worship Him with the highest devotion.

তাঁর দেহে পূজা পাইলে কৃষ্ণ পূজা পায় ।
নিভৃতে কহিল তোরে — রাখিবে হিয়ায় ॥ ৫৯ ॥

tāṁra dehe pūjā pāile kṛṣṇa pūjā pāẏa |
nibhṛte kahila tore — rākhibe hiẏāẏa || 59 ||

tanra dehe puja paile — when His body receives worship; krishna puja paya — Krishna receives worship; nibhrite kahila tore — I told you in private; rakhibe hiyaya — keep it in your heart

59When He receives worship, Krishna receives it.
I have told you this in private — keep it in your heart.

আমি আর গদাধর-পণ্ডিত-গোসাঞি ।
নিত্যানন্দ, অদ্বৈত, শ্রীবাস, রামাই ॥ ৬০ ॥

āmi āra gadādhara-paṇḍita-gosāñi |
nityānanda, adbaita, śrībāsa, rāmāi || 60 ||

ami ara gadadhara-pandita-gosani — I and Gadadhara Pandita Gosani; nityananda — Nityananda; advaita — Advaita; srivasa — Srivasa; ramai — Ramai

60I and Gadadhara Pandita Gosani,
Nityananda, Advaita, Srivasa, Ramai —

জানিবে আমার দেহ এ সব সহিতে ।
অন্তর কহিল তোরে রাখিহ হিয়াতে ॥ ৬১ ॥

jānibe āmāra deha e saba sahite |
antara kahila tore rākhiha hiẏāte || 61 ||

janibe amara deha — know that My body; e saba sahite — [is one] with all these; antara kahila tore — I have opened My heart to you; rakhiha hiyate — keep it in your heart

61know that My body is one with all of them.12
I have opened My heart to you — keep it in your heart."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সে মুরারি বৈদ্যরাজ ।
অন্তরে জানিল প্রভুর অন্তরের কাজ ॥ ৬২ ॥

e bola śuniñā se murāri baidyarāja |
antare jānila prabhura antarera kāja || 62 ||

e bola shuniña — hearing this; se murari vaidyaraja — Murari, king of physicians; antare janila — understood in his heart; prabhura antarera kaja — the purpose in the Lord's heart

62Hearing this, Murari, king of physicians,
understood in his heart what the Lord intended in His.

কান্দিতে কান্দিতে প্রভুর পড়িলা চরণে ।
নিশ্চয় জানিলা প্রভুর সন্ন্যাস-করণে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

kāndite kāndite prabhura paṛilā caraṇe |
niścaẏa jānilā prabhura sannyāsa-karaṇe || 63 ||

kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; prabhura padila charane — he fell at the Lord's feet; nishchaya janila — he knew for certain; prabhura sannyasa-karane — of the Lord's taking sannyasa

63Weeping, he fell at the Lord's feet:
he understood that the Lord would surely take sannyasa.

হরিদাস-চরণে করিয়া নমস্কার ।
আত্মসমর্পণ করে বিনয় অপার ॥ ৬৪ ॥

haridāsa-caraṇe kariẏā namaskāra |
ātmasamarpaṇa kare binaẏa apāra || 64 ||

haridasa-charane — at Haridasa's feet; kariya namaskara — bowing; atma-samarpana kare — he surrenders himself; vinaya apara — with boundless humility

64Bowing at Haridasa's feet,
he surrenders himself [to the Lord] with boundless humility.

মুরারি-কান্দনা প্রভু শুনিতে কাতর ।
আস্তে-ব্যস্তে উঠি' চলিলা নিজঘর ॥ ৬৫ ॥

murāri-kāndanā prabhu śunite kātara |
āste-byaste uṭhi' calilā nijaghara || 65 ||

murari-kandana — Murari's weeping; prabhu shunite katara — the Lord is pained to hear; aste-vyaste uthi — rising hastily; chalila nijaghara — went home

65The Lord cannot bear to hear Murari weep:
He hastily rose and went home.

মুরারিকে প্রবোধ করিলা এই বাণী ।
তোমার নিকটে নিরন্তর আছি আমি ॥ ৬৬ ॥

murārike prabodha karilā ei bāṇī |
tomāra nikaṭe nirantara āchi āmi || 66 ||

murarike prabodha karila — He consoled Murari; ei vani — with these words; tomara nikate — near you; nirantara achhi ami — I always abide

66He consoled Murari with these words:
"I am always near you.

সন্ন্যাস করিব — তার আছয়ে বিলম্ব ।
পরিণামে যে কহিল এই অবলম্ব ॥ ৬৭ ॥

sannyāsa kariba — tāra āchaẏe bilamba |
pariṇāme ye kahila ei abalamba || 67 ||

sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; tara achhaye vilamba — that is still some time off; pariname — in the end; ye kahila ei avalamba — what I said is the support

67My sannyasa is still some time off;
and what I have told you will be your support in the end."13

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু নিজঘরে যায় ।
কাতর-অন্তরে কথা এ লোচন গায় ॥ ৬৮ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu nijaghare yāẏa |
kātara-antare kathā e locana gāẏa || 68 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu nijaghare yaya — the Lord goes home; katara-antare — with an aching heart; katha e lochana gaya — this Lochana sings of it

68Saying this, the Lord goes home;
with an aching heart Lochana sings of it.

The Consolation of the Devotees

Raga karunashri; disha: "Ah, alas, alas! The Lord at whose remembrance sorrow ends — ah, alas! If He goes, I shall die, O Gauranga; whose face shall I look upon then, O Gauranga?"

রজনী বঞ্চয়ে প্রভু আনন্দ-হিয়ায় ।
আছিল অধিক করি' পিরীতি বাঢ়ায় ॥ ৬৮+১ ॥

rajanī bañcaẏe prabhu ānanda-hiẏāẏa |
āchila adhika kari' pirīti bāṛhāẏa || 68+1 ||

rajani vanchaye prabhu — the Lord spends the night; ananda-hiyaya — with joy in His heart; achhila adhika kari — more than before; piriti badhaya — He increases love

68+1The Lord spends the night with joy in His heart14
and increases [His] love [for all] even more than before.

মায়েরে সন্তোষ করে হৃদয় জানিয়া ।
যে কথায় থাকয়ে অন্তর সুস্থ হৈয়া ॥ ৬৮+২ ॥

māẏere santoṣa kare hṛdaẏa jāniẏā |
ye kathāẏa thākaẏe antara sustha haiẏā || 68+2 ||

mayere santosha kare — He gladdens His mother; hridaya janiya — knowing her heart; ye kathaya thakaye — with words by which remains; antara sustha haiya — the heart at ease

68+2Knowing His mother's heart, He gladdens her
with such words as set her heart at ease.

পুরজনে পরিজনে যারে যে উচিত ।
এইমনে সভাকারে করয়ে পিরীত ॥ ৬৮+৩ ॥

purajane parijane yāre ye ucita |
eimane sabhākāre karaẏe pirīta || 68+3 ||

purajane parijane — to townsfolk and household; yare ye uchita — to each as is fitting; eimane sabhakare — thus to all; karaye pirita — He shows love

68+3With townsfolk and household — with each as is fitting —
thus He shows love to all.

বৈরাগ্য-আবেশ প্রভু পরিত্যাগ করি' ।
ঘরে ঘরে নিজ প্রেম পরকাশ করি ॥ ৬৮+৪ ॥

bairāgya-ābeśa prabhu parityāga kari' |
ghare ghare nija prema parakāśa kari || 68+4 ||

vairagya-avesha — absorption in renunciation; prabhu parityaga kari — the Lord laying aside; ghare ghare — in every house; nija prema parakasha kari — reveals His love

68+4Laying aside [His] absorption in renunciation,
the Lord reveals His love in every house.

কারু ঘরে হাস্য-পরিহাস-কথা কহে ।
যার যেন হিয়া তেনমতে সভে মোহে ॥ ৬৮+৫ ॥

kāru ghare hāsya-parihāsa-kathā kahe |
yāra yena hiẏā tenamate sabhe mohe || 68+5 ||

karu ghare — in someone's house; hasya-parihasa-katha kahe — He jests and laughs; yara yena hiya — as each heart is; tenamate sabhe mohe — so He charms all

68+5In one house He jests and laughs —
He finds the way to each heart and charms everyone.

আছিলা গুপত-বেশে যারা সঙ্গে যাইতে ।
মায়ার প্রভাবে তারা আইলা ঘরেতে ॥ ৬৮+৬ ॥

āchilā gupata-beśe yārā saṅge yāite |
māẏāra prabhābe tārā āilā gharete || 68+6 ||

achhila gupata-beshe — had been in secret disguise; yara sange yaite — those [ready] to go with [Him]; mayara prabhave — by the power of maya; tara aila gharete — they came home

68+6Those who had been [ready] in secret, in disguise, to go with Him —
by the power of [His] maya returned home.15

নানা আভরণ পরে, শ্রীঅঙ্গে চন্দন ।
হাস-বিলাস-রসময় অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৬৮+৭ ॥

nānā ābharaṇa pare, śrīaṅge candana |
hāsa-bilāsa-rasamaẏa anukṣaṇa || 68+7 ||

nana abharana pare — He wears various ornaments; sri-ange chandana — sandal on His holy body; hasa-vilasa-rasamaya — full of laughter, play and rasa; anukshana — every moment

68+7He wears various ornaments, sandal paste on His holy body,
and every moment He is full of laughter, play and rasa.

সব লোকে জানিলেক — না হবে সন্ন্যাস ।
স্বচ্ছন্দ হইল সব লোক নিজ-বাস ॥ ৬৮+৮ ॥

saba loke jānileka — nā habe sannyāsa |
sbacchanda haila saba loka nija-bāsa || 68+8 ||

saba loke janileka — everyone concluded; na habe sannyasa — there will be no sannyasa; svachchhanda haila — were at ease; saba loka nija-vasa — all the people [went] home

68+8Everyone concluded there would be no sannyasa,
and all the people [went] home at ease.16

শয়ন-মন্দিরে প্রভু শয়ন করিলা ।
তাম্বূল-স্তবক-করে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আইলা ॥ ৬৮+৯ ॥

śaẏana-mandire prabhu śaẏana karilā |
tāmbūla-stabaka-kare biṣṇupriẏā āilā || 68+9 ||

shayana-mandire — in the bedchamber; prabhu shayana karila — the Lord lay down; tambula-stavaka-kare — with betel in hand; vishnupriya aila — Vishnupriya came

68+9The Lord lay down in His chamber,
and Vishnupriya came with a bunch of betel in her hand.

হাসিয়া সন্তোষে প্রভু আইস আইস বোলে ।
পরম পিরীতি করি' বসাইল কোলে ॥ ৬৮+১০ ॥

hāsiẏā santoṣe prabhu āisa āisa bole |
parama pirīti kari' basāila kole || 68+10 ||

hasiya santoshe — smiling with delight; prabhu aisa aisa bole — the Lord says, come, come; parama piriti kari — with great tenderness; vasaila kole — seated her on His lap

68+10Smiling with delight, the Lord says, "Come, come!" —
and with great tenderness seated her on His lap.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া প্রভু-অঙ্গে চন্দন লেপিল ।
অগুরু কস্তূরী গন্ধে তিলক রচিল ॥ ৬৮+১১ ॥

biṣṇupriẏā prabhu-aṅge candana lepila |
aguru kastūrī gandhe tilaka racila || 68+11 ||

vishnupriya prabhu-ange — Vishnupriya on the Lord's body; chandana lepila — smeared sandal; aguru kasturi gandhe — with fragrant aguru and musk; tilaka rachila — drew a tilaka

68+11Vishnupriya anointed the Lord's body with sandal
and drew a tilaka with fragrant aguru and musk,

দিব্য মালতীর মালা দিল গোরা-অঙ্গে ।
শ্রীমুখে তাম্বূল তুলি' দিল নানা রঙ্গে ॥ ৬৮+১২ ॥

dibya mālatīra mālā dila gorā-aṅge |
śrīmukhe tāmbūla tuli' dila nānā raṅge || 68+12 ||

divya malatira mala — a divine malati garland; dila gora-ange — put on Gora's body; sri-mukhe tambula tuli dila — placed betel in His holy mouth; nana range — playfully

68+12put a divine garland of malati on Gora's body
and with tender jests placed betel in His holy mouth.

তবে মহাপ্রভু সে রসিক-শিরোমণি ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-অঙ্গে বেশ করেন আপনি ॥ ৬৮+১৩ ॥

tabe mahāprabhu se rasika-śiromaṇi |
biṣṇupriẏā-aṅge beśa karena āpani || 68+13 ||

tabe mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; se rasika-shiromani — the crown of rasikas; vishnupriya-ange besha — Vishnupriya's adornment; karena apani — does Himself

68+13Then Mahaprabhu, the crown of connoisseurs of rasa,
Himself began to adorn Vishnupriya.

দীর্ঘ কেশ কামের চামর জিনি' আভা ।
কবরী বান্ধিয়া দিল মালতীর আভা ॥ ৬৮+১৪ ॥

dīrgha keśa kāmera cāmara jini' ābhā |
kabarī bāndhiẏā dila mālatīra ābhā || 68+14 ||

dirgha kesha — the long hair; kamera chamara jini abha — outshining Kama's whisk; kabari bandhiya dila — He braided it; malatira abha — with the gleam of malati

68+14Her long hair, whose lustre surpasses Kama's whisk,
He braided and decked with malati flowers —

মেঘ বন্দী হৈল যেন চাঁদের কলাতে ।
কিবা উগারিয়া গিলে না পারি বুঝিতে ॥ ৬৮+১৫ ॥

megha bandī haila yena cāṁdera kalāte |
kibā ugāriẏā gile nā pāri bujhite || 68+15 ||

megha bandi haila — a cloud was captured; yena chandera kalate — as if by the crescent moon; kiba ugariya gile — or does it swallow and return it; na pari bujhite — one cannot tell

68+15as if the crescent moon had captured a cloud —
or is [the moon] swallowing it and giving it back? — one cannot tell.

সুন্দর ললাটে দিল সিন্দূরের বিন্দু ।
দিবাকর কোলে যেন রহিয়াছে ইন্দু ॥ ৬৮+১৬ ॥

sundara lalāṭe dila sindūrera bindu |
dibākara kole yena rahiẏāche indu || 68+16 ||

sundara lalate — on the lovely forehead; dila sindurera bindu — He placed a dot of sindura; divakara kole — the sun on the lap; yena rahiyachhe indu — as if of the moon

68+16On her lovely forehead He placed a dot of sindura —
as if the moon had taken the sun onto its lap.

সিন্দূরের চৌদিকে চন্দন-বিন্দু আর ।
রাশি কোলে সূর্য যেন ধায় দেখিবার ॥ ৬৮+১৭ ॥

sindūrera caudike candana-bindu āra |
rāśi kole sūrya yena dhāẏa dekhibāra || 68+17 ||

sindurera chaudike — around the sindura; chandana-bindu ara — and dots of sandal; rashi kole surya — a host, the sun in the lap; yena dhaya dekhibara — as if running to see

68+17And around the sindura, dots of sandal,
as if a host [of stars] had rushed to see the sun in the moon's lap.17

খঞ্জন-নয়ানে দিল অঞ্জনের রেখ ।
ভুরু কাম-কামানের গুণ করিলেক ॥ ৬৮+১৮ ॥

khañjana-naẏāne dila añjanera rekha |
bhuru kāma-kāmānera guṇa karileka || 68+18 ||

khanjana-nayane — on the wagtail eyes; dila anjanera rekha — drew a line of collyrium; bhuru kama-kamanera guna — the brows the string of Kama's bow; karileka — He made

68+18On her eyes, restless as wagtails, He drew lines of collyrium
and made her brows the string of Kama's bow.

অগুরু কস্তূরী গন্ধ কুচোপরি লেপে ।
দিব্য বস্ত্রে রচিল কাঁচলি পরতেকে ॥ ৬৮+১৯ ॥

aguru kastūrī gandha kucopari lepe |
dibya bastre racila kāṁcali parateke || 68+19 ||

aguru kasturi gandha — fragrant aguru and musk; kuchopari lepe — He smears on her bosom; divya vastre — of divine cloth; rachila kanchali parateke — fashioned a bodice

68+19He anointed her bosom with fragrant aguru and musk
and fitted her a bodice of divine cloth.

নানা অলঙ্কারে অঙ্গ ভূষিল তাহার ।
তাম্বূল হাসির সঙ্গে বিহরে অপার ॥ ৬৮+২০ ॥

nānā alaṅkāre aṅga bhūṣila tāhāra |
tāmbūla hāsira saṅge bihare apāra || 68+20 ||

nana alankare — with various ornaments; anga bhushila tahara — adorned her body; tambula hasira sange — with betel and laughter; vihare apara — plays without end

68+20He adorned her with various ornaments —
and plays [with her] endlessly, laughing and offering betel.

ত্রৈলোক্য-অদ্ভুত রূপ নিরখে বদন ।
অধর বান্ধুলী সাধে করয়ে চুম্বন ॥ ৬৮+২১ ॥

trailokya-adbhuta rūpa nirakhe badana |
adhara bāndhulī sādhe karaẏe cumbana || 68+21 ||

trailokya-adbhuta rupa — beauty wondrous in the three worlds; nirakhe vadana — He gazes at her face; adhara bandhuli — lips [red as] bandhuli; sadhe karaye chumbana — lovingly kisses

68+21He gazes at her face, whose beauty is a wonder of the three worlds,
and lovingly kisses her lips, red as the bandhuli flower.

ক্ষণে ভুজলতা বেড়ি' আলিঙ্গন করে ।
নব কমলিনী যেন করিবর-কোরে ॥ ৬৮+২২ ॥

kṣaṇe bhujalatā beṛi' āliṅgana kare |
naba kamalinī yena karibara-kore || 68+22 ||

kshane bhujalata bedi — now enfolding with creeper-arms; alingana kare — embraces; nava kamalini yena — like a young lotus; karivara-kore — in a lordly elephant's grasp

68+22Now He enfolds her in His creeper-arms and embraces her —
like a young lotus in the trunk of a lordly elephant.

নানা রস বিথারয়ে বিনোদ-নাগর ।
আনের কি কাজ — কাম-অগোচর ॥ ৬৮+২৩ ॥

nānā rasa bithāraẏe binoda-nāgara |
ānera ki kāja — kāma-agocara || 68+23 ||

nana rasa vitharaye — unfolds many rasas; vinoda-nagara — the playful Nagara; anera ki kaja — what of others; kama-agochara — beyond the reach of Kama

68+23Many rasas the playful Nagara unfolds —
what of others: this is beyond the reach of Kama.18

সুমেরুর কোলে যেন বিজুরী প্রকাশ ।
মদন মুগধে দেখি' রতির বিলাস ॥ ৬৮+২৪ ॥

sumerura kole yena bijurī prakāśa |
madana mugadhe dekhi' ratira bilāsa || 68+24 ||

sumerura kole — in the lap of Sumeru; yena bijuri prakasha — as if lightning flashed; madana mugadhe — Madana is bewildered; dekhi ratira vilasa — seeing the play of love

68+24Like lightning flashing in the lap of Sumeru:
Madana himself is bewildered seeing this play of love.

হৃদয়-উপরে থোয় — না শোয়ায় শয্যায় ।
পাশ পালটিতে নারে — দোঁহে এক মজ্জা ॥ ৬৮+২৫ ॥

hṛdaẏa-upare thoẏa — nā śoẏāẏa śayyāẏa |
pāśa pālaṭite nāre — doṁhe eka majjā || 68+25 ||

hridaya-upare thoya — He keeps her on His breast; na shoyaya shayyaya — does not lay her on the bed; pasha palatite nare — they cannot turn aside; donhe eka majja — the two are one being

68+25He holds her on His breast and does not lay her on the bed;
they cannot turn from each other — the two are as one being.

বুকে বুকে মুখে মুখে রজনী গোঙায় ।
রস-অবসাদে দোঁহে সুখে নিদ্রা যায় ॥ ৬৮+২৬ ॥

buke buke mukhe mukhe rajanī goṅāẏa |
rasa-abasāde doṁhe sukhe nidrā yāẏa || 68+26 ||

buke buke mukhe mukhe — breast to breast, face to face; rajani gongaya — they pass the night; rasa-avasade — in the languor of rasa; donhe sukhe nidra yaya — both fall blissfully asleep

68+26Breast to breast, face to face they pass the night;
in the languor of rasa both fall blissfully asleep.

রজনীর শেষে প্রভু উঠিলা সত্বর ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া নিদ্রা যায় অতি ঘোরতর ॥ ৬৮+২৭ ॥

rajanīra śeṣe prabhu uṭhilā satbara |
biṣṇupriẏā nidrā yāẏa ati ghoratara || 68+27 ||

rajanira sheshe — at the end of the night; prabhu uthila satvara — the Lord rose quickly; vishnupriya nidra yaya — Vishnupriya sleeps; ati ghoratara — very deeply

68+27At the end of the night the Lord rose quickly;
Vishnupriya sleeps a deep sleep.

বৈরাগ্য-সময়ে প্রেমা উথারে অধিক ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব বলি' উনমত চিত ॥ ৬৮+২৮ ॥

bairāgya-samaẏe premā uthāre adhika |
sannyāsa kariba bali' unamata cita || 68+28 ||

vairagya-samaye — at the time of renunciation; prema uthare adhika — prema surges higher; sannyasa kariba bali — thinking, "I shall take sannyasa"; unamata chita — His heart is as if maddened

68+28At the time of renunciation His prema surges higher still;
with the thought "I shall take sannyasa" His heart is as if maddened.

এ সময়ে বিথারয়ে রঙ্গ-রস-ভাব ।
ইহার কারণ কিছু শুন লাভালাভ ॥ ৬৮+২৯ ॥

e samaẏe bithāraẏe raṅga-rasa-bhāba |
ihāra kāraṇa kichu śuna lābhālābha || 68+29 ||

e samaye — at such a time; vitharaye ranga-rasa-bhava — He unfolds play, rasa and bhava; ihara karana kichhu — the reason for this; shuna labhalabha — hear what is gained

68+29Why at such a time He unfolds play, rasa and bhava —
hear the reason, and what is gained by it.

যে জন যেমনে ভজে তারে তেন প্রভু ।
ভজন অধিক ন্যূন না করয়ে কভু ॥ ৬৮+৩০ ॥

ye jana yemane bhaje tāre tena prabhu |
bhajana adhika nyūna nā karaẏe kabhu || 68+30 ||

ye jana yemane bhaje — as a person serves; tare tena prabhu — so the Lord [responds] to him; bhajana adhika nyuna — more or less than the service; na karaye kabhu — He never gives

68+30As one serves, so the Lord responds to him:
He never repays service with more or with less.19

তাহাতে বিশেষ আছে অধিকারী-ভেদ ।
অমায়া সমায়া ভক্তি সবেদ নির্বেদ ॥ ৬৮+৩১ ॥

tāhāte biśeṣa āche adhikārī-bheda |
amāẏā samāẏā bhakti sabeda nirbeda || 68+31 ||

tahate vishesha achhe — in this there is a special; adhikari-bheda — distinction of qualification; amaya samaya bhakti — devotion without and with guile; saveda nirveda — with knowledge and with detachment (?)

68+31But here there is a special distinction according to [the devotees'] qualification:
devotion is without guile and with guile, with knowledge and with detachment.20

ভক্তি বিনু কৃষ্ণ ভজিবারে নারে কেহো ।
অমায়া নিশ্চলা ভক্তি হয় সেহো ॥ ৬৮+৩২ ॥

bhakti binu kṛṣṇa bhajibāre nāre keho |
amāẏā niścalā bhakti haẏa seho || 68+32 ||

bhakti vinu — without bhakti; krishna bhajibare nare keho — no one can serve Krishna; amaya nishchala bhakti — bhakti without guile and unwavering; haya seho — that is it

68+32Without bhakti no one can serve Krishna;
[the highest] bhakti is that which is without guile and unwavering.

বিনি অনুরাগে প্রেমভক্তি হয় যবে ।
কৃষ্ণে বন্দী করিবারে নারে কেহো তবে ॥ ৬৮+৩৩ ॥

bini anurāge premabhakti haẏa yabe |
kṛṣṇe bandī karibāre nāre keho tabe || 68+33 ||

vini anurage — without anuraga; prema-bhakti haya yabe — when there is prema-bhakti; krishne bandi karibare — to capture Krishna; nare keho tabe — then no one can

68+33And when prema-bhakti is without anuraga,
no one can capture Krishna.

ঐছন ঠাকুর গৌর করুণার সিন্ধু ।
অনুরাগে প্রেমার ভিখারী দীনবন্ধু ॥ ৬৮+৩৪ ॥

aichana ṭhākura gaura karuṇāra sindhu |
anurāge premāra bhikhārī dīnabandhu || 68+34 ||

aichhana thakura gaura — such is Thakura Gaura; karunara sindhu — the ocean of mercy; anurage premara bhikhari — a beggar for prema with anuraga; dinabandhu — the friend of the lowly

68+34Such is Thakura Gaura, the ocean of mercy:
the friend of the lowly, He Himself begs for prema with anuraga.

করুণায় প্রকাশয়ে নিজ অনুরাগ ।
বিচ্ছেদে হৃদয়ে যেন বাড়ে তার ভাব ॥ ৬৮+৩৫ ॥

karuṇāẏa prakāśaẏe nija anurāga |
bicchede hṛdaẏe yena bāṛe tāra bhāba || 68+35 ||

karunaya prakashaye — in mercy He reveals; nija anuraga — His own anuraga; vichchhede hridaye — in separation, in the heart; yena badhe tara bhava — so that her bhava may grow

68+35In mercy He reveals His own anuraga,
so that in separation her bhava may grow in her heart.

ভাবসঙ্গে যে জন দেখয়ে মোর অঙ্গ ।
তার সহ মোর ভাব কভু নহে ভঙ্গ ॥ ৬৮+৩৬ ॥

bhābasaṅge ye jana dekhaẏe mora aṅga |
tāra saha mora bhāba kabhu nahe bhaṅga || 68+36 ||

bhava-sange — with bhava; ye jana dekhaye mora anga — whoever sees My body; tara saha mora bhava — My bhava with him; kabhu nahe bhanga — is never broken

68+36"Whoever sees My body with bhava —
with him My bhava is never broken."

এহেন করুণানিধি আছে আর কে ।
আপনা বান্ধিতে প্রেম-অনুরাগ দে ॥ ৬৮+৩৭ ॥

ehena karuṇānidhi āche āra ke |
āpanā bāndhite prema-anurāga de || 68+37 ||

ehena karuna-nidhi — such a treasury of mercy; achhe ara ke — who else is there; apana bandhite — to bind Himself; prema-anuraga de — gives prema and anuraga

68+37Who else is such a treasury of mercy,
who gives prema and anuraga so as to bind His very Self?

এই সে কারণে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়াকে প্রসাদ ।
ইহা জানি' মনে কেহো না কর প্রমাদ ॥ ৬৮+৩৮ ॥

ei se kāraṇe biṣṇupriẏāke prasāda |
ihā jāni' mane keho nā kara pramāda || 68+38 ||

ei se karane — this is why; vishnupriyake prasada — grace to Vishnupriya; iha jani — knowing this; mane keho na kara pramada — let no one err in mind

68+38This is why [He showed] grace to Vishnupriya —
knowing this, let no one go astray in mind.21

এ প্রেমভক্তি প্রভু করিব প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচন দাস ॥ ৬৮+৩৯ ॥

e premabhakti prabhu kariba prakāśa |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locana dāsa || 68+39 ||

e prema-bhakti — this prema-bhakti; prabhu kariba prakasha — the Lord will reveal; ananda-hridaye — with joy in his heart; kahe e lochana dasa — says this Lochana Dasa

68+39This prema-bhakti the Lord will reveal —
with joy in his heart says this Lochana Dasa.

✦

Notes

  1. The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface ("Vishnupriya-devi's grief; the Lord consoles her with many sweet words and, after instructing her in the truth, shows the four-armed form of Narayana; the coming of Srinivasa, Murari and other devotees; the Lord consoles them"). Before v. 1 B (the 1983 edition) has the disha "Gauranga, oh, why did You come to Nadia? O Gauranga, Gauranga!"; A lacks it.
  2. The end of the line is unclear (A and B: "অভিপারা"); translated by sense.
  3. Stanza 11+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition or the 1903 edition). From here B's numbering is one higher than A's.
  4. Lit. "taking Your nichhani" — the rite in which a lover takes the beloved's misfortunes upon herself. The beginning of the stanza is corrupt in A and B; restored by sense.
  5. Vishnupriya is the Lord's eternal consort, His Bhu-shakti (en/21, note 9); her pastimes with the Lord are not mundane (en/35, note 8).
  6. "Empty" (মিছা, "false") in the sense of vain, transient; not the mayavada doctrine of the world's unreality (cf. en/37, note 14).
  7. Not monism: souls are one in nature (all are the Lord's energy, His prakriti) and in themselves neither male nor female; the imagined "two" is identification with the body. The one Purusha, the enjoyer, is Krishna.
  8. That is, the yogamaya that hid His divinity from Vishnupriya (cf. en/37, note 16).
  9. Cf. the promise to Shachi (en/37, v. 220).
  10. Cf. en/36, v. 155; Murari 2.18.19–23.
  11. Advaita is Maha-Vishnu (en/27, note 8); cf. Murari 2.18.29: "a part of the Lord". Vv. 52–61 — cf. Murari 2.18.25–30.
  12. Ramai is Sri Rama Pandita, Srivasa's brother. In the 1903 edition vv. 60–61 are bracketed as the reading of some manuscripts.
  13. In A v. 63 is misprinted "৬২", and the numbers of vv. 47 and 50 are not printed; restored from the neighbours. V. 66 is corrupt in A and restored from B and C.
  14. This section is not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (1922); it is translated from Haridasa Shastri's edition (1983), where it comes under the heading "The Consolation of the Devotees" (भक्तगणे प्रबोध) right after v. 68. The 1903 edition has it in the main text (some couplets bracketed as readings of some manuscripts). Bhaktisiddhanta apparently deliberately left out this description of the Lord's night with Vishnupriya, written in the spirit of nagari-bhava (cf. en/09, note 9): Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following Vrindavana Dasa, see in the Gaura of Navadvipa a model of the strict propriety of a brahmana householder. We translate it under the rule on the additions of the 1983 edition; Lochana Dasa himself explains the meaning of this pastime in vv. 68+29–68+38.
  15. Maya here is the Lord's lila-shakti (yogamaya), which conceals His intention for the sake of the lila.
  16. So in C ("না হবে সন্ন্যাস"); B has "লহিব সন্ন্যাস" ("will take sannyasa"), which contradicts the sense.
  17. The forehead is the moon, the dot of sindura the sun, the dots of sandal the stars. The end of the line is corrupt in B ("রাশি কোলে"); one manuscript of the 1903 edition has "like stars in the lap of the sun".
  18. The reading is unclear (B: "আহক অনের কাজ", C: "অস্ুক আনের কাখ"); the sense is that what in others would be a matter of lust is here "beyond the reach of Kama": the love of the Lord and His shakti transcends mundane desire (cf. v. 68+38).
  19. Cf. Bhagavad-gita 4.11.
  20. The couplet is obscure ("অমায়া সমায়া ভক্তি সবেদ নির্বেদ"; C: "এ বেদ নির্বেদ"); translated by the probable sense.
  21. That is, let no one think that the Lord's night with Vishnupriya before sannyasa is mundane love: it is a grace by which the Lord deepens her prema in separation (v. 68+35).
